                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.gradMode m n (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicCos ν G) a b

declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} {P : ℝ} {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds}
  {w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ} {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  0 < P →
    0 < w₀ →
      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w₀ ≤ w y) →
        Measurable w →
          Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric w →
            (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics, -β ∈ h.harmonics) →
              (0, 0) ∈ h.harmonics →
                (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space) (i : Fin 3),
                    (W σ y).ofLp i = ∑ β ∈ h.harmonics, (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y i).re) →
                  (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
                    (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                        ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                          √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤ h.ampGradW β y) →
                      (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                          ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                            √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                  (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
                              h.ampVort β y) →
                        (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                    (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                                h.ampGradVort β y) →
                          (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
                            (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤
                                  h.supGradVort y) →
                              (∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                        (m.epsP β).frame •
                                          (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                            (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                    (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                                (∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                          (m.muP β).frame •
                                            (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                              (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                      (m.muP β).speed y) →
                                  (∀ (β : Fin nE),
                                      ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                        ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes,
                                          Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                                    (∀ (β : Fin nM),
                                        ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                          ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes,
                                            Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                                      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                          (∑ β, |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| * (m.muP β).wt y) ^ 2 ≤
                                            ratio *
                                              ∑ β,
                                                |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                    |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                                  (m.muP β).wt y) →
                                        0 ≤ ratio →
                                          (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                                            (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                ∑ β, Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsGradSup) →
                                              (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                  m.convD (m.classOf ι) y ≤ 1 - m.shareHat h ι y) →
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.OtherAdmissibleClauses m P h w W HW w₀
                                                  epsSup epsGradSup ratio

declarations.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup X] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ X] [CompleteSpace X] (f : ℝ × ℝ → X),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable f
      ((MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc 0 1)).prod
        (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (-Real.pi) Real.pi))) →
    (∀ (τ θ : ℝ), f (τ, θ + 2 * Real.pi) = f (τ, θ)) →
      ∀ (Φ : ℝ → X →L[ℝ] ℝ),
        Continuous Φ →
          (∀ (φ : ℝ) (x : X), ‖(Φ φ) x‖ ≤ ‖x‖) →
            (∀ (φ : ℝ), Φ (φ + 2 * Real.pi) = Φ φ) →
              ∀ (ν k : ℤ),
                1 / (2 * ↑Real.pi) *
                    ∫ (τ : ℝ) in 0..1,
                      ∫ (φ : ℝ) in 0..2 * Real.pi,
                        Breakdown.Coercive.Internal.ModeRotation.expFactor (ν, k) τ φ * ↑((Φ φ) (f (τ, φ))) =
                  (1 / (2 * ↑Real.pi) *
                      ∫ (θ : ℝ) in 0..2 * Real.pi,
                        Complex.exp (-↑(↑k * θ) * Complex.I) *
                          ↑((Φ θ) (∫ (τ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1, Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * ↑ν * τ) • f (τ, θ)))) +
                    Complex.I *
                      (1 / (2 * ↑Real.pi) *
                        ∫ (θ : ℝ) in 0..2 * Real.pi,
                          Complex.exp (-↑(↑k * θ) * Complex.I) *
                            ↑((Φ θ) (-∫ (τ : ℝ) in Set.Icc 0 1, Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * ↑ν * τ) • f (τ, θ))))

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.OtherAdmissibleClauses.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} {P : ℝ} {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds}
  {w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ} {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {w₀ epsSup epsGradSup ratio : ℝ},
  0 < P →
    0 < w₀ →
      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w₀ ≤ w y) →
        Measurable w →
          Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric w →
            (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics, -β ∈ h.harmonics) →
              (0, 0) ∈ h.harmonics →
                (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space) (i : Fin 3),
                    (W σ y).ofLp i = ∑ β ∈ h.harmonics, (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y i).re) →
                  (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                      ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
                    (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                        ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                          √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤ h.ampGradW β y) →
                      (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                          ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                            √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                  (Breakdown.curlOfGrad (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
                              h.ampVort β y) →
                        (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                            ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                    (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                                h.ampGradVort β y) →
                          (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                              ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤ h.supVort y) →
                            (∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤
                                  h.supGradVort y) →
                              (∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                        (m.epsP β).frame •
                                          (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                            (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                    (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                                (∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                    ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) + (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                          (m.muP β).frame •
                                            (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 • Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                              (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 • Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                      (m.muP β).speed y) →
                                  (∀ (β : Fin nE),
                                      ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                        ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes,
                                          Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame ι) →
                                    (∀ (β : Fin nM),
                                        ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                          ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes,
                                            Ωs ≤ Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι) →
                                      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                          (∑ β, |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| * (m.muP β).wt y) ^ 2 ≤
                                            ratio *
                                              ∑ β,
                                                |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                    |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                                  (m.muP β).wt y) →
                                        0 ≤ ratio →
                                          (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                                            (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                ∑ β, Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsGradSup) →
                                              (∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                  m.convD (m.classOf ι) y ≤ 1 - m.shareHat h ι y) →
                                                Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.OtherAdmissibleClauses m P h w W HW w₀
                                                  epsSup epsGradSup ratio

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.Internal.RowParts.row_parts_identity
declarations.type:
∀ (K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox),
  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K →
    ∀ (k : ℝ) (s : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ × ℝ → ℂ) (t : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ × ℝ → ℂ)
      (R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.RowProfile),
      (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), R.grad p = fun a b => s a b p) →
        (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), R.lap p = fun a => ∑ c, t a c c p) →
          (∀ (e : Fin 2) (z : ℝ),
              R.radialSide e z = fun a =>
                Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.radialStripTrace (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.sideRadius K e)
                  (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.otherRadius K e) (s a 0) (t a 0 0) z) →
            (∀ (e : Fin 2) (r : ℝ),
                R.heightSide e r = fun a =>
                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.heightStripTrace (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.sideHeight K e)
                    (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.otherHeight K e) (s a 2) (t a 2 2) r) →
              (∀ (a b : Fin 3), MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (s a b) K.rect MeasureTheory.volume) →
                (∀ (a b c : Fin 3),
                    MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun p => ↑p.1 * t a b c p) K.rect MeasureTheory.volume) →
                  (∀ (a : Fin 3) (χ τ : ℝ → ℝ),
                      ContDiff ℝ 1 χ →
                        χ K.r₁ = 0 →
                          χ K.r₂ = 0 →
                            Continuous τ →
                              MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                                  (fun p => t a 0 0 p * ↑(χ p.1 * τ p.2) + s a 0 p * ↑(deriv χ p.1 * τ p.2)) K.rect
                                  MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                                    t a 0 0 p * ↑(χ p.1 * τ p.2) + s a 0 p * ↑(deriv χ p.1 * τ p.2) =
                                  0) →
                    (∀ (a : Fin 3) (A χ : ℝ → ℝ),
                        ContDiff ℝ 1 A →
                          ContDiff ℝ 1 χ →
                            χ K.z₁ = 0 →
                              χ K.z₂ = 0 →
                                MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                                    (fun p => ↑p.1 * (t a 2 2 p * ↑(A p.1 * χ p.2) + s a 2 p * ↑(A p.1 * deriv χ p.2)))
                                    K.rect MeasureTheory.volume ∧
                                  ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                                      ↑p.1 * (t a 2 2 p * ↑(A p.1 * χ p.2) + s a 2 p * ↑(A p.1 * deriv χ p.2)) =
                                    0) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin 3),
                          ∀ᵐ (p : ℝ × ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K.rect,
                            ↑p.1 * t a 1 1 p =
                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.turnVector k (fun b => s b 1 p) a + s a 0 p) →
                        ∀ (φ : Fin 3 → Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly),
                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.rowPairing K R.lap φ =
                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.rowBoundaryGrad K R φ -
                              ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                                ↑p.1 *
                                  ∑ a,
                                    ∑ b,
                                      R.grad p a b *
                                        (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.testGrad K k φ p a b)

declarations.type:
∀ {k : ℕ} {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} (D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM) (K : Fin D.mesh.count),
  (D.mesh.box K).rect ⊆ Set.Ici 0 ×ˢ Set.Ici 0 →
    MeasurableSet (D.mesh.box K).rect →
      ∀ (L Sl : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
        Sl ⊆ L →
          ∀ (w : ℤ × ℤ → ℝ),
            (∀ ι ∈ Sl, 0 < w ι) →
              ∀ (G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space)
                (Xs Xe : Fin k ⊕ Fin k → ℤ × ℤ → ℝ × ℝ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℂ),
                (∀ (i : Fin k) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                    ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect, ∀ (a b : Fin 3), Xs (Sum.inr i) ι p a b = Xe (Sum.inr i) ι p a b) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin k),
                      ∀ ι ∈ L,
                        ι ∉ Sl →
                          ∀ p ∈ (D.mesh.box K).rect, ∀ (a b : Fin 3), Xs (Sum.inl i) ι p a b = Xe (Sum.inl i) ι p a b) →
                    (∀ ι ∈ Sl,
                        ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                          Breakdown.CertCell.InstancePair.Internal.SqWeighted
                            (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) fun p =>
                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt D.azimuthOrder ι G a b p) →
                      (∀ (i : Fin k),
                          ∀ ι ∈ Sl,
                            ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                              Breakdown.CertCell.InstancePair.Internal.SqWeighted
                                (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) fun p => Xs (Sum.inl i) ι p a b) →
                        (∀ (i : Fin k),
                            ∀ ι ∈ Sl,
                              ∀ (a b : Fin 3),
                                Breakdown.CertCell.InstancePair.Internal.SqWeighted
                                  (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (D.mesh.box K).rect) fun p => Xe (Sum.inl i) ι p a b) →
                          ∀ (κ ζ : Fin k → ℝ),
                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.pairShare D K L Xs κ ζ G ≤
                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.pairShare D K L Xe κ ζ G +
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.pairStrainSlack D K Sl w G +
                                (∑ i, κ i ^ 2) *
                                  ∑ ι ∈ Sl,
                                    (4 * w ι)⁻¹ *

                  {motive :

                        Sort u} →

                            (weight_lower : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w₀ ≤ w y) →
                              (weight_measurable : Measurable w) →
                                (weight_axi : Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric w) →
                                  (harmonics_neg : ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics, -β ∈ h.harmonics) →

                                              ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                √(Breakdown.cnormSq (Breakdown.modeVel β W σ y)) ≤ h.ampW β y) →
                                          (ampGradW_ge :

                                                ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                  √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                                        (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y)) ≤
                                                    h.ampGradW β y) →
                                            (ampVort_ge :
                                                ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                                  ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                    √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                                          (Breakdown.curlOfGrad
                                                            (Breakdown.modeGrad β (Breakdown.gradField W) σ y))) ≤
                                                      h.ampVort β y) →

                                                  ∀ β ∈ h.harmonics,
                                                    ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                      √(Breakdown.cnormSq
                                                            (Breakdown.curlGradOfSecondDeriv
                                                              (Breakdown.modeSecondDeriv β HW σ y))) ≤
                                                        h.ampGradVort β y) →
                                                (supVort_ge :
                                                    ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                      ‖Breakdown.curlVec (fderiv ℝ (W σ) (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤
                                                        h.supVort y) →
                                                  (supGradVort_ge :
                                                      ∀ (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                        ‖Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.vortGradMap
                                                              (HW σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y))‖ ≤
                                                          h.supGradVort y) →
                                                    (epsSpeed_ge :
                                                        ∀ (β : Fin nE) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                          ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) +
                                                                  (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                                                (m.epsP β).frame •
                                                                  (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 •
                                                                      Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                                    (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 •
                                                                      Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                                            (m.epsP β).speed y) →
                                                      (muSpeed_ge :
                                                          ∀ (β : Fin nM) (σ φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                            ‖W σ (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) +
                                                                    (1 / 2) • Breakdown.axialRot φ y -
                                                                  (m.muP β).frame •
                                                                    (-(Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 1 •
                                                                        Breakdown.unitVector 0 +
                                                                      (Breakdown.axialRot φ y).ofLp 0 •
                                                                        Breakdown.unitVector 1)‖ ≤
                                                              (m.muP β).speed y) →
                                                        (eps_oneSided :
                                                            ∀ (β : Fin nE),
                                                              ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                                                ∀ ι ∈ (m.epsP β).modes,
                                                                  Ωs ≤
                                                                    Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.epsP β).frame
                                                                      ι) →
                                                          (mu_oneSided :

                                                                ∃ Ωs > 0,
                                                                  ∀ ι ∈ (m.muP β).modes,
                                                                    Ωs ≤
                                                                      Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P (m.muP β).frame
                                                                        ι) →
                                                            (mu_ratio :
                                                                ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space) (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                                                  (∑ β,
                                                                        |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                                          (m.muP β).wt y) ^
                                                                      2 ≤
                                                                    ratio *
                                                                      ∑ β,
                                                                        |Breakdown.PieceWeights.sgn (m.muP β).modes ι| *
                                                                            |Breakdown.PieceWeights.frameFreq P
                                                                                (m.muP β).frame ι| *
                                                                          (m.muP β).wt y) →
                                                              (ratio_nonneg : 0 ≤ ratio) →
                                                                (eps_sum_le :
                                                                    ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                      ∑ β, (m.epsP β).wt y ≤ epsSup) →
                                                                  (eps_grad_sum_le :
                                                                      ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                        ∑ β,
                                                                            Breakdown.PieceWeights.wtGrad (m.epsP β).wt
                                                                              y ≤
                                                                          epsGradSup) →

        {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.InstanceConsequences D → Sort u} →
          ((rowField_measurable :
                ∀ (a : Fin D.cert.rowCount),
                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => D.cert.rowField a z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
              (rowField_periodic : ∀ (a : Fin D.cert.rowCount), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (D.cert.rowField a)) →
                (rowField_finite :
                    ∀ (a : Fin D.cert.rowCount),
                      (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖D.cert.rowField a σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                  (rowField_orthonormal :
                      ∀ (a b : Fin D.cert.rowCount),
                        Breakdown.periodPairing (D.cert.rowField a) (D.cert.rowField b) = if a = b then 1 else 0) →
                    (rowWeight_nonneg : ∀ (a : Fin D.cert.rowCount), 0 ≤ D.cert.rowWeight a) →
                      (rowWeight_le : ∀ (a : Fin D.cert.rowCount), D.cert.rowWeight a ≤ D.cert.rowBound ^ 2) →
                        (rows_class_form :
                            ∀ (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                                Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →

                                      D.coercivity * D.cert.rows F ^ 2 =

                  ∀ (a : Fin D.cert.rowCount),
                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => D.cert.rowField a z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                (rowField_periodic : ∀ (a : Fin D.cert.rowCount), Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic (D.cert.rowField a)) →
                  (rowField_finite :
                      ∀ (a : Fin D.cert.rowCount),
                        (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖D.cert.rowField a σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤) →
                    (rowField_orthonormal :
                        ∀ (a b : Fin D.cert.rowCount),
                          Breakdown.periodPairing (D.cert.rowField a) (D.cert.rowField b) = if a = b then 1 else 0) →
                      (rowWeight_nonneg : ∀ (a : Fin D.cert.rowCount), 0 ≤ D.cert.rowWeight a) →
                        (rowWeight_le : ∀ (a : Fin D.cert.rowCount), D.cert.rowWeight a ≤ D.cert.rowBound ^ 2) →
                          (rows_class_form :
                              ∀ (F : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space),
                                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => F z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume →
                                  Breakdown.IsTimePeriodic F →
                                    (Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖F σ y‖ ^ 2) < ⊤ →
                                      (∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                          F σ (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint (F σ y)) →
                                        D.coercivity * D.cert.rows F ^ 2 =
                                          4 * Real.pi *
                                            ∑ K,
                                              ∑ ι ∈ D.mesh.tested K,
                                                D.rows.testWeight K ι *
                                                  (star (D.rows.cellMoment D.mesh.box D.azimuthOrder K ι F) ⬝ᵥ
                                                      (D.rows.testBlockMatrix D.mesh.box K ι)⁻¹.mulVec
                                                        (D.rows.cellMoment D.mesh.box D.azimuthOrder K ι F)).re) →
                            (weights :
                                ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
                                  Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.AdmissibleWeightClauses (D.pieces q) ∧
                                    Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.WeightFlipClauses (D.pieces q) ∧
                                      (D.pieces q).c = D.coercivity) →
                              (actuators :
                                  ∀ q ∈ D.cert.params,
